placeLabels.l03Contract: CONTEXT_PLACE_LABEL_ONLY; no locative relation, copula, subject, person, tense, aspect or interrogative inferred.

intendedReading: Is he/she at school / study domain?
pros: Uses an existing explicitly locative relation token instead of turning place labels into predicates.
Preserves ERU first and KE final, matching separately scoped structural evidence.
risks: Positive ERU+RUMI+PLACE is not currently licensed by the negated-location patch.
Adding KE creates a new locative yes/no question microgrammar.
Would effectively turn context/place labels into predicates without RUMI.
Creates more novel ordering than necessary.

options.schema: NO NEW PLACE QUESTION; retain labels only
risks: Does not expand L04 question capability.

recommendation.reason: A is the only proposed expansion that keeps VALIVAN/PARAZAMO as place arguments rather than silently converting them into locative predicates, because it makes the already-existing scoped locative relation RUMI explicit.

humanGate.approvalEffect: Select Option A for candidate materialization only. It does not validate positive RUMI syntax or locative question grammar.
humanGate.nextIfApproved: Materialize exactly ERU RUMI VALIVAN KE and ERU RUMI PARAZAMO KE, run writing coverage, then open separate linguistic validation.

forbiddenGeneralizations: VALIVAN/PARAZAMO do not become locative predicates.
RUMI is not generalized to every location construction.
No universal word order is inferred.
